long_biography.plain_text:
When Pablo Aramburuzabala died without a completed succession plan, María Asunción Aramburuzabala had to protect the family's Grupo Modelo stake in a sceptical boardroom. She retained the family's board influence, took responsibility for two failing yeast businesses and returned them to profit after learning their operations from purchasing to overnight production.

That hands-on test led to negotiations with Anheuser-Busch and the brewery's vice-chairmanship. Aramburuzabala also created Tresalia Capital with her mother and sister to organise and diversify the family assets. She later transferred daily executive authority to Rodolfo Pérez while retaining the chair, turning an abrupt inheritance crisis into a planned generational transition.
long_biography.html:
When Pablo Aramburuzabala died without a completed succession plan, María Asunción Aramburuzabala had to protect the family's Grupo Modelo stake in a sceptical boardroom. She retained the family's board influence, took responsibility for two failing yeast businesses and returned them to profit after learning their operations from purchasing to overnight production.

That hands-on test led to negotiations with Anheuser-Busch and the brewery's vice-chairmanship. Aramburuzabala also created Tresalia Capital with her mother and sister to organise and diversify the family assets. She later transferred daily executive authority to Rodolfo Pérez while retaining the chair, turning an abrupt inheritance crisis into a planned generational transition.

uncertainties.detail: The rare full Larregui surname, Mexican details and Forbes Halo bridge exclude a namesake, while multiple authoritative filings and current profiles corroborate the correctly accented saved name. The existing Wikipedia type is preserved without duplication; only the missing verified Forbes profile is proposed.

The Forbes profile still calls Aramburuzabala Tresalia's chief executive and Coty director. Later Bloomberg, AB InBev, El Financiero, Forbes México and SEC evidence show that Rodolfo Pérez assumed Tresalia's daily executive leadership in 2022, she remained chair or president, and she left Coty's board in February 2025. The dossier therefore uses Chair of Tresalia Capital and does not repeat the stale Coty role.

Tresalia has substantial real-estate activity through Abilia, alongside securities, private equity and venture investments. Public sources do not publish a complete current asset allocation, but consistently define Tresalia as the overarching family investment office with three divisions. Finance & Investments therefore clears the threshold; Real Estate is the strongest considered alternative if later audited asset weights show that property dominates the total portfolio.

The fortune began with a large inherited brewery stake, so no self-made classification is defensible. Inherited and expanded is preferred over Inherited because direct evidence documents the yeast-business turnaround, brewery governance and negotiations, retention of the family interest, and subsequent creation and diversification of Tresalia.

Aramburuzabala was historically a Grupo Modelo vice-chair and Tresalia chief executive, but Grupo Modelo was sold and daily family-office management passed to Rodolfo Pérez. Her current chairmanship, principal status and control of the succession process support Family office principal. Operator is retained only as a historical alternative, not a current classification.

Forbes México supplies the exact birth date and Mexico City birthplace, corroborated in part by AB InBev and the saved age snapshot. No distinct second nationality is evidenced. Search results surfaced multiple same-name LinkedIn pages and no independently linked personal Instagram or personal website, so none is proposed. The exact Forbes profile is verified and added.

Beer industry captures the specific origin sector, and Private equity captures the distinct current private-capital mandate. Beverage manufacturing would duplicate Beer industry; Asset management and Venture capital would multiply overlapping Tresalia investment categories; Property developer would overstate personal practice at Abilia. The two-tag active set is therefore the minimum defensible coverage, with no closed-world candidate created.

Halo is used only as an identity bridge. The historical relationship, vessel characteristics and market history are excluded from both biographies and all wealth decisions. Current net-worth estimates, rankings and short-lived portfolio positions are likewise omitted as non-durable context.
